meaning: Làm dịu bớt, giảm nhẹ tác hại hoặc mức độ nghiêm trọng
definitionEn: to make something less harmful, unpleasant, or bad
exampleSentence: Governments must enforce stringent environmental laws to mitigate the detrimental effects of global warming.

meaning: Làm trầm trọng thêm, làm tồi tệ hơn tình hình
definitionEn: to make something that is already bad even worse
exampleSentence: Unchecked deforestation has severely exacerbated soil erosion and biodiversity loss in tropical regions.

meaning: Phổ biến khắp nơi, nhan nhản ở mọi chỗ
definitionEn: seeming to be everywhere at the same time
exampleSentence: Artificial intelligence algorithms have become ubiquitous across modern digital platforms.

meaning: Thay thế, soán ngôi vị trí của cái khác
definitionEn: to replace something or someone, often as a result of being more modern
exampleSentence: Automated software is unlikely to completely supplant empathetic and experienced teachers.

meaning: Thuộc về sư phạm, phương pháp giáo dục
definitionEn: relating to the methods and theory of teaching
exampleSentence: Innovative pedagogical practices encourage students to foster critical thinking rather than rote learning.

meaning: Thuộc về nhân khẩu học, thành phần dân số
definitionEn: relating to the structure and characteristics of populations
exampleSentence: Many developed nations are currently grappling with profound demographic changes due to falling birth rates.

meaning: Chiếm ưu thế áp đảo, chiếm phần lớn nhất
definitionEn: to be the largest, most important, or most noticeable part of something
basicEquivalent: be the biggest part, account for most
exampleSentence: Housing expenditure dominated household budgets in Country A, accounting for nearly 40% of total spending.

meaning: Vượt qua, bỏ xa đối thủ khác về số lượng hoặc tốc độ
definitionEn: to be or become greater in amount, degree, or success than something else
exampleSentence: By 2030, clean energy generation is projected to comfortably outstrip that of traditional fossil fuels.
